key_notes: Key 1 (t=3.8s): Initial archival pose of flying-saucer; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=4.92s): Mid-sequence articulation of flying-saucer; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=6.16s): Peak dynamic extension of flying-saucer over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=7.4s): Follow-through and settle of flying-saucer with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of flying-saucer (3.8s..7.4s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
